observability_triage.rationale: The grouped feedback is split into independent checks over content-control types, placeholder metadata, table/text-box geometry, paragraph spacing, borders, date controls, and theme color definitions in built DOCX packages. The request to review bullet appearance with Tariq is a human-review action without an objective target value and is explicitly left out of deterministic scoring.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Proposal controls for Advantages, Settings, Attachments, Headline, and Date, the Guidance reflections control, and the Board Seminar agenda control use real Word placeholder-backed content controls rather than literal ordinary text; each has a valid placeholder reference and w:showingPlcHdr so fixture input replaces the instruction rather than appending to it.

setup: Build the Proposal, Guidance, and Board Seminar DOCX fixtures.

expected_observations.subject: required tagged controls found exactly once
required controls missing w:showingPlcHdr or a resolvable w:placeholder/w:docPart
required controls whose deterministic fixture input leaves the original instruction concatenated with user text

determinism_controls: Select controls by frozen semantic w:tag, never paragraph order.
Resolve placeholder building blocks from actual DOCX parts and apply the same fixed replacement text to each control.

setup: A required location contains bracketed instruction as ordinary w:t text outside a content control.
negative_cases.action: Resolve the required semantic tag and placeholder reference.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails even if the visible words resemble a placeholder.

negative_cases.action: Compare grid geometry before and after long-text insertion.
negative_cases.expected_failure_or_absence: The criterion fails even if a short default string appears acceptable.

uncovered_items.evidence: The bullet clause asks for review with Tariq because sizes and spacing 'look incorrect' but supplies no numeric typography, geometry, or approved visual reference.
uncovered_items.required_action: Exclude REQ_BULLET_VISUAL_DESIGN.execution.observed_behavior from deterministic scoring until an approved numeric or frozen-reference specification exists.
